author: Samsung
description:
The world’s first Privacy Display on mobile. Meet your built-in privacy screen, only on Galaxy S26 Ultra. Privacy Display will allow you to protect your private information by hiding your full screen from other people's view. Or, you can choose what you want to hide such as certain apps, or incoming notifications. Simply choose what and when to share with Privacy Display. Learn more: http://smsng.co/S26Ultra_Main-Film_yt

Q: What is Privacy Display, and how does it work?
A: Privacy Display is a built-in privacy screen that uses innovative technology to protect your device's display from prying eyes in public places. When activated, the screen's pixels move dynamically to keep the display visible when you look at it straight on, but then appear dimmed when seen from the side by the people around you. You can have the full screen hidden from view, or choose the custom settings instead, and set Privacy Display to activate only for notifications or certain apps.
